content: Morning everyone. Anyone else's home wifi decide to die at 2am for no reason?
Mine's been rock solid, might be your router's firmware. When did you last update it?
Honestly no idea. Could be years.
Update it today, don't wait. Old firmware is basically an open invitation.
Speaking of open invitations, are we still on for the hike Saturday?
Yes! Weather looks clear, low chance of rain until Sunday.
Perfect. Same trailhead as last time?
Same one. I'll bring the trail mix again.
I'll bring a proper first aid kit this time, last hike we had nothing for blisters.
Learning from experience, I like it.
Can someone remind me what time we're leaving on Saturday? I keep forgetting.
7am sharp, or as sharp as this group ever manages.
Fair point, we were 40 minutes late last month.
That was one time and it was because Alan forgot his boots.
I will never live that down apparently.
Unrelated, but has anyone tried the new ramen place on 5th street?
Went there last week, broth was incredible, noodles a bit overcooked though.
Good to know, might go Friday before the hike prep.
Bring me back a photo of the menu if you go.
Will do.
Okay switching gears, I need eyes on a bug. My recursive function is blowing the stack on inputs over 10000.
Classic. Convert it to an iterative approach with an explicit stack, or add memoization if it's overlapping subproblems.
It's a tree traversal, not much overlap to memoize.
Then iterative with your own stack structure is the way. Recursion depth in most languages isn't built for that.
Makes sense, I'll refactor tonight and report back.
Send the diff when you're done, I want to see the before and after.
Will do, might take me an hour or two.
While you're at it, does anyone have opinions on tail call optimization in general? Worth relying on?
Depends entirely on the language. Never assume your runtime guarantees it unless documented explicitly.
That's basically what I suspected, thanks for confirming.
On an unrelated note, anyone read anything good lately? I finished my book and need a new one.
I just started a biography on the history of computing, really dense but fascinating.
Send me the title when you get a chance.
Will do after this call I'm in.
I've been rereading old sci-fi. There's something comforting about predictions from decades ago that got everything both right and wrong.
Which one are you on now?
One about a future where everyone communicates by thought alone. No privacy at all, kind of unsettling in hindsight.
That sounds like every social media platform already, honestly.
Ha, fair.
Reminder that we have the quarterly sync call tomorrow at 10am. Please actually show up on time this quarter.
Noted, setting three alarms.
I'll be there, already blocked my calendar.
Same, though I might be five minutes late, kid has a school thing that morning.
Five minutes is fine, forty is not.
Understood.
Does anyone know a good recipe for a quick weeknight dinner? I'm out of ideas.
Sheet pan chicken and vegetables, maybe twenty minutes of actual effort.
That sounds doable, what temperature and how long?
425 for about 25 minutes, flip everything halfway.
Trying it tonight, thank you.
Let us know how it turns out.
Will report back with photos.
Question for the group, anyone using a new note taking app they actually stuck with?
I switched to a plain text file system with folders, sounds boring but nothing has beaten it for me.
No search though?
grep exists for a reason.
Can't argue with that logic.
Update on the bug from earlier: iterative version works, no more stack overflow even at 100000 elements.
Nice, how much slower or faster is it compared to the recursive version?
About 15 percent faster actually, wasn't expecting that.
Send the diff, you promised.
Sending it over now.
Got it, looks clean. Good work.
Happy birthday to Isaac by the way! Saw it on the calendar.
Oh, thank you! Forgot people could even see that.
Happy birthday! Hope it's a good one.
Happy birthday, hope cake is involved somewhere today.
Cake is very much involved, thank you all.
Happy birthday! Don't work too hard today.
No promises, but I appreciate it.
The weather this week has been unbelievably gray, is anyone else feeling it?
Same, I haven't seen actual sun in what feels like five days.
It's supposed to clear up by the weekend for our hike at least.
Small mercies.
Sheet pan chicken update: it was excellent, thank you Marie.
Told you it was easy.
Adding it to my regular rotation.
Reminder, the quarterly sync got moved to 11am instead of 10, conflict with another meeting on my end.
Updating my calendar now.
Noted, thanks for the heads up.
That actually works better for me, thank you.
Does anyone want to split a group order from that ramen place before the hike Friday?
I'm in, get me the spicy miso one.
I'll pass this time, still full from lunch.
More for us then.
Question, is the trail from Saturday dog friendly? Thinking of bringing mine.
Should be fine, it's mostly wide dirt path, nothing too narrow or steep.
Great, he could use the exercise.
Bring extra water for him too, it gets warm by midday.
Good call, will pack extra.
Sync call notes are up in the shared doc if anyone missed it or wants to reference something.
Thanks, reading through now.
Appreciate you writing those up every time.
Somebody has to.
Ramen order is in, should be ready by 6.
Perfect, I'll swing by after work.
Saturday morning, meeting at the trailhead again, 7am, everyone bring water and snacks.
Boots are already by the door this time, learned my lesson.
See everyone bright and early then.
Looking forward to it, been a long week.
